title: List of Barbarian dialogue
html:
Spoiler warning: The following content contains unhidden spoilers. Read at your own risk.
This page is in the process of being constructed or reformatted. You are welcome to contribute as well.
Last edited on 2025-08-05. If multiple days have passed since, this template should be removed.

Below is a list of all Barbarian-tagged dialogue, sorted by roll, then DC (if it has one).

Note: This is far from a comprehensive list. It is closer to a list of tagged dialogue located on various pages on the wiki.

  • [BARBARIAN] [STRENGTH] Wrench the printing press open and rip out the loaded headline. (DC 18)
  • [BARBARIAN] I don't care where you go, but it's time for all of you to leave. (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] WAKE UP, SQUIDFACE
  • [BARBARIAN] Counter her rage with your own, unleashing your battle frenzy within her mind.'"`UNIQ--ref-00000077-QINU`"'
  • [BARBARIAN] Grip the pod's lid and pull.
  • [BARBARIAN] ROAR.
  • [BARBARIAN] ROAR.
  • [BARBARIAN] An animal shows its true strength only when cornered. Show me yours. FIGHT.
  • [BARBARIAN] Don't waste good anger on your thoughts - use it on that target!
  • [BARBARIAN] [RANGER] Forget the city - the wilds have everything you need.
  • [BARBARIAN] Get back! This cowardly worm is trying to poison you!
  • [BARBARIAN] How about the goblin spines I'd ripped out with my bare hands?
  • [BARBARIAN] I agree - no more questions. More blood. YOURS.
  • [BARBARIAN] I do not submit. And I don't want submission from you. Show me your rage.
  • [BARBARIAN] I suffer from boredom. The cure is ripping you apart.
  • [BARBARIAN] Just kill them already - all this torture is pointless.
  • [BARBARIAN] Only cowards run from a fight.
  • [BARBARIAN] Only cowards run from a fight.
  • [BARBARIAN] Only cowards run from a fight.
  • [BARBARIAN] Someone who will snap both you and your weapons in two unless you lower them.
  • [BARBARIAN] Such blind obedience. Stand up to this Portyr - prove to her that you are not a weakling.
  • [BARBARIAN] Well, I'm thinking about your arms - they're like tree trunks. I approve.
  • [BARBARIAN] Why would I play a game that imitates war when I can fight any time I want?
  • [BARBARIAN] WOOF!
  • [BARBARIAN] Yes, damn it!
  • [BARBARIAN] You DARE challenge me? I'm going to rip you apart.
  • [BARBARIAN] You talk too much. Come - meet your end, beast.
  • [BARBARIAN] Your skull will make a fine chalice one I plug those beady eye sockets.
  • [BARBARIAN] [CONSTITUTION] CHUG! CHUG! CHUG! (DC 18 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [CONSTITUTION] LET THE TADPOLE FEED ON YOUR RAGE. MAKE IT STRONG. (DC 18 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [CONSTITUTION] AGAIN! DRINK! (DC 16 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [CONSTITUTION] CHUG THE BEER. (DC 14 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [DECEPTION] I'm here for the Faerûn tavern brawl championships. (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Cut the price or I cut you into little pieces. CHOOSE. (DC 25 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Could've done a lot worse. A lot worse. (DC 20 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Fine - but you make them leave. No thugs. No coward shit. OR ELSE. (DC 20)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] How about I show you a more traditional burial? Though your skin might not like the flames. (DC 20)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] How about I spare your life. That tempting enough? (DC 20)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] ROAR! (DC 20 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] ROAR! (DC 20 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] ROAR! (DC 20 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Something of little value - your life. (DC 20 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Thank you for the list - now I know which parts of you to break first. (DC 20)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Too much. Cut your price down to size or I'll cut you down to size. (DC 20 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Turn out your pockets too. NOW. (DC 20 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] You can leave alive, or you can roast over my campfire. (DC 20 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Cowardly Gondians - do not let these people torment you! Fight. (DC 18 )
  • [BERSERKER] [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Cowardly Gondians - do not let these people torment you! Fight. (DC 18 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] COWARDLY GONDIANS - FIGHT BACK! FIGHT WITH ME! (DC 18 )
  • [BERSERKER] [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] I'LL MAKE YOU SMELL OF DEAD MEAT. MOVE. (DC 18 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] LEAVE, LITTLE WULBREN. OR DIE. (DC 18)
  • [BERSERKER] [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Leave, Wulbren - or I'll cleave that thick skull of yours in two. (DC 18)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Leave, Wulbren - or I'll cleave that thick skull of yours in two. (DC 18)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Let me in, or I snap you in two. (DC 18)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Let me in, or I snap you in two. (DC 18)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] NO. FOR FREE. (DC 18)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Tell Oskar what he wants to hear. OUT WITH IT. (DC 18 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] You can smell the blood of my enemies, that is all. Want to join my scent? (DC 18 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] You can smell the blood of my enemies, that is all. Want to join my scent? (DC 18 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] You can smell the blood of my enemies, that's all. Want to join my smell? (DC 18 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] You'd sprain your wrist trying. (DC 18)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] ROAR AT THIS INJUSTICE. (DC 16 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Match it growl for growl. (DC 16)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] No songs. Just screams. (DC 16 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] ROAR. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] FIGHT, COWARD. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] FOOT. KISS. NOW! (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] I'M LAUGHING AT YOUR PUNY RUTTING. (DC 15)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] I'M LAUGHING AT YOUR PUNY RUTTING. (DC 15)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Mine. (DC 15 )
  • [BERSERKER] [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] ROAR. (DC 15)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] A lifetime can be very short. Hand over the manuscript. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] And everything will stay fine. So long as you let me down into your vault. (DC 15)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Back down or bleed. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Back down or bleed. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [NON-DARK URGE] [INTIMIDATION] Back down, or bleed. (DC 15)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Careful. You won't kill me, but you will make me mad. (DC 15)
  • [BERSERKER] [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] CHEST. MINE NOW. (DC 15)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Enough talking. I'll have that cargo, or I'll have your head. (DC 15)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Enough talking. I'll have that cargo, or I'll have your head. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Give it a try. I'm hungry for a little fun. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Give me that shipment or die. Choose. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] I said. Let. Me. PASS. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] I want you to know the face of your killer. Or you can let me in. (DC 15)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] I'll have it all. Or I'll just settle for your life. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] I'm Nine Fingers new muscle. Let me pass, or I'l show you why I was hired. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Leave. Or die. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Let. Me. Through. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Mine. Now. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] NO. KISS MY FOOT. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Not scared of your pinpricks. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Rules can be broken. And so can goblin bones. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] She's just a cub. Let her go, or tangle with me. (DC 15)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Show. Me. Now. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Start explaining, or I start breaking bones. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] That bauble worth a thrashing? (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] That bauble worth a thrashing? (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] That's nature's bounty. Helps the trees grow. Eat it, or else. (DC 15)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] The cargo. Give it to me. Or else. (DC 15)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] The chest is mine now. Only question is if you live or not. (DC 15)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] You get nothing. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] You'd try kill me? I AM THE ABSOLUTE'S FIST! (DC 15)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Because I'll rip your tongue out, shove it down your throat, then stomp on your 'creations' until they are dirt beneath my feet. (DC 14 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] GO. NOW. (DC 14 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] No - that lantern is mine, by order of the Absolute. Give it - now. (DC 14 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Tell me, or this'll be a very short-lived return. (DC 12 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] ROAR! (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] ROAR. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Mine now. Leave. (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Try and stop me. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Growl threateningly. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Grunt back menacingly at the mummy. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Be sure. Attack. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Be sure. Attack. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] CARGO'S MINE NOW. GET OUT. (DC 10 )
  • [BERSERKER] [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] CARGO'S MINE NOW. GET OUT. (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Cargo's mine now. Goodbye. (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Cargo's mine now. Goodbye. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Come, then. Once I've plucked you, I'll have your cub for dessert. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Do it, you stupid creature. Unless you want to be ripped apart, piece by piece? (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Feel differently? How about you feel dead? (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] I ask the questions. Now talk. (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] I don't need to transform to kill everyone. Stand down. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] I go where I like. Move. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] I know exactly what you owe. Pay up. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] I'll buy my own drinks. Money. Now. (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] I'll have answers, or I'll have blood. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Might be tempted - unless you do as I say. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Mine now. Leave. (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Mine now. Leave. (DC 10)
  • [BERSERKER] [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] MONEY, OR YOUR LIFE. CHOOSE. (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] More. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] MORE. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] MOVE YOUR BOAT, OR SINK. MAKE THE CHOICE. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] MOVE YOUR BOAT, OR SINK. MAKE THE CHOICE. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] No. Coin. Now. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Not looking for new friends. Looking for coin. Now. (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Not yours - mine. Leave. Now. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Not yours - mine. Leave. Now. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Not yours - mine. Leave. Now. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Open. Now. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] SLEEP, OR DIE. YOUR CHOICE. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Strike the child, go on. See what happens. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Take your shot. Go on. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] The truth. Now. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Try and I will take your skulls as trophies (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Watch your tongue, or I'll take it. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Watch your tongue, or I'll take it. (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] What about you? I'm feeling hungry... (DC 10)
  • [BERSERKER] [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] WORDS DON'T PAY. COIN DOES. (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] You don't want me angry. Trust me - one animal to another. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] You keen on dying? Happy to help. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] YOU KNOW SOMETHING. SPEAK. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] You saw nothing, or I'll crush your eyes like grapes. Got it? (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] You sure they're worth dying over? (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Accept my help or die in this pit - choose. (DC 6 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Accept my help or die in this pit - choose. (DC 6 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] ROAR. (DC 5 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] MORE! (DC 5 )
  • [BERSERKER] [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] PAY UP. (DC 5)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] STOP OR I'LL BASH YOUR SKULLS TOGETHER MYSELF. (DC 5 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] STOP OR I'LL BASH YOUR SKULLS TOGETHER MYSELF. (DC 5 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Away from the coin, or I'll make a headpiece from your feathers. (DC 5 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Growl. (DC 5)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Back down. Or else. (DC 5)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Bad liar, but good killer. The coin - now. (DC 5 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Coin first. Then I go. (DC 5)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Coin first. Then I go. (DC 5 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Did I say you could ask questions? (DC 5 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Go on, try it. (DC 5 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [ILLITHID] [INTIMIDATION] I am a True Soul. Doubt me at your peril. (DC 5 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] I could eat you whole - you can pretend I'm gone, once you're in the dark of my belly. (DC 5)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Smokepowder. Information. NOW. (DC 5 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Tell me, or you'll be my breakfast. (DC 5)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] The gnomes are free. Now walk away, while I'm feeling generous. (DC 5 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Thieving children wind up dead around here. Do as he says. (DC 5 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] You are a noble fowl. Fast. Sharp. VENGEFUL! (DC 5 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [PERFORMANCE] ROAR. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [PERFORMANCE] Drown out the harpies with a ROAR. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [PERFORMANCE] Try really hard not to roar your words. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [PERFORMANCE] Stare him down, as you have so many beasts in the wild. (DC 5)
  • [BARBARIAN] [PERSUASION] Kill yourself, coward. Then you'll return to Avernus. You'll be free. (DC 30 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [PERSUASION] Kill yourself, coward. Then you'll return to Avernus. You'll be free. (DC 21 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [PERSUASION] I wield my anger like a blade, but it does not rule me. I am no more 'bad' than you are. (DC 20)
  • [BARBARIAN] [PERSUASION] The goblins tried to hurt you. Show them what hurt really means. (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] [PERSUASION] You could have fought back. You deserve no forgiveness, COWARD! (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [PERSUASION] Shoot the trap down. I'll tear it apart before anyone else gets hurt. (DC 5)
  • [BARBARIAN] [STRENGTH] Channel all your rage - and pull. (DC 21 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [STRENGTH] BREAK FREE. (DC 20 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [STRENGTH] Pick up a rock to smash the mirror. (DC 15)
  • [BARBARIAN] [STRENGTH] Pick up a rock to smash the mirror. (DC 15)

  • [BARBARIAN] [STRENGTH] Don't give up. Tear this thing open. (DC 10)
